text: Can every airport in the network reach every other airport by some sequence of flights?

result.description: Airline routes between the 500 airports with the most routes. Directed: an edge A->B is a non-stop route from A to B. weight = great-circle distance in km; airlines = number of airlines flying the route. Node ids are IATA codes. Snapshot of OpenFlights data from 2014, not current schedules.
Zachary's karate club: friendships among 34 club members, before the club split in two. Undirected and unweighted. 'club' is the faction each member joined after the split.
Characters in Victor Hugo's Les Miserables. Undirected; an edge joins two characters who appear in the same chapter, weight = number of such chapters.
A small sample course catalogue (illustrative, not a real curriculum). Directed acyclic: an edge A->B means course A is a prerequisite of course B.
Synthetic sample: 16 students and the projects (10) each is willing to work on. Undirected and bipartite; 'side' says whether a node is a student or a project.
